name: 贝丝·长辙
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1227
who: Bess of the Longrut family, a halfling matriarch of the Honey-Mead Hills, seventy years old and looking it: about 101 cm, short and round but with a straight back. A cloud of white curly hair gathered into one bunch with a red cloth band, the knot the Longrut family has always tied. A ruddy face, its wrinkles all smile-folds that stay unsmoothed even when she scolds. Eyes the Longrut grass-green, looking first at whether the person in front of her has eaten. Both hands are covered in old pot-burn scars, the palms thick with callus. A warm, bossy, no-nonsense air; she can lift a big copper pot that feeds thirty by herself.
face: FACE, as in the references: the youthful-faced halfling look kept, but aged by seventy years: round soft cheeks flushed pink, deep smile-wrinkles at the eyes and mouth, a small nose, bright grass-green eyes with white lashes and thin white brows, a wide mouth with a firm, scolding set. Skin shadows a soft warm pink.
build: About 101 cm, small and round, a straight back.
palette: honey brown and caravan rust, white hair, bright red band, tarnished copper, grass green
casual: Her everyday clothes: a deep brown wool carter's coat with two wheel-rut lines embroidered down the back, a greasy-bright apron over it whose hem is sewn with a ring of small bronze bells, a long-handled wooden ladle at her belt, a tin tube on her back holding this year's long scroll, soft low boots. A bell hangs at her neck on a cord. She stands square and stout, one fist on her hip, a frowning, fond look.
private: At home by her own big hearth: the coat off, a long-sleeved ankle-length brown wool dress with a clean linen apron, sleeves rolled to the elbow, the white hair loose from its band under a plain kerchief, soft slippers. She stirs a small pot with the ladle and tastes it, a content, pleased look.
battle: Holding her camp kitchen against a rush, a halfling matriarch not a swordswoman: the carter's coat belted tight, the apron on, the sleeves rolled, the bells at her hem tied up so they do not ring. She grips the huge copper pot by its handle in both hands, lifted as a shield in front of her, the ladle held up in the right hand like a short club; a fierce, planted stance, jaw set, the mouth firm.
formal: At the feast of the caravan owners: a wine-red wool carter's coat with two wheel ruts stitched on the back, worn open over a clean white apron with the bronze bells at the hem, a silver pin of two wheel ruts at the collar, the red band tied in a neat bow on the white hair, the ladle thrust through her belt as always, one bell that rings by itself now and then. She stands upright with hands folded, a proud, severe look.
art: A portrait with the face large, the green eyes looking straight at the viewer, an unimpressed motherly look. Warm orange light from a hearth on one side, steam rising in front of her. Foreground blur: the rim of the big copper pot and drifting steam. She wears the carter's coat, apron and bell at her neck.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: the copper pot lifted in both hands as a shield, the ladle raised, a fierce, planted stance.

name: 瑟蕾娅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1381
who: Seraia, a human stretcher-bearer of the White Candle, forty-seven years old, about 167 cm, medium height with a broad back and thick shoulders. Her hair was crow-feather black and is now half white, tied behind the head with a strip of white cloth. Honey-coloured eyes with a small white glint in each pupil like a candle flame reflected, which brightens when she looks at the wounded. Butcher's-family hands, thick-knuckled, nails cut to the quick, wax burn marks across the backs. A deep strap-mark across one shoulder from years of carrying poles. A calm, steady, unhurried air that quietens a queue just by standing at the tent.
face: FACE, as in the references: a plain, strong, kind woman's face of about forty-seven, NOT young: fine lines at the eye corners and mouth, honey-coloured almond eyes with a small white glint in the pupils, level dark brows going grey, a straight nose, a firm gentle mouth. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 167 cm, broad-backed and thick-shouldered with a sturdy waist and legs: a heavy strong frame, a C-cup, a straight waist and firmly rounded hips.
palette: candle white and ash grey, honey amber, dark crow black, a little dried-blood brown
casual: The grey-white knee-length short robe of the White Candle stretcher corps, a leather belt carrying needles, gut thread and a tin box of white candle stubs, a white cloth wound round the left arm with a white candle painted on it, sturdy boots, a carrying-pole strap across one shoulder. She stands straight with her hands loosely clasped, a quiet look.
private: Off duty in a bare camp tent: a plain undyed linen shirt buttoned to the collar, a dark wool skirt to the shins, wool stockings, the white cloth taken from her hair so it falls loose; she is winding a length of thread onto a stick, a tired, gentle look.
battle: Carrying a wounded soldier out of a fight: the grey-white short robe belted close, leather bracers, the armband on, a pack of candle stubs at her hip; the stretcher pole over one shoulder, her other arm bracing the front end low, the body crouched and braced to run. A steady, intent, unafraid look.
formal: At the White Candle shrine on the day of the candles: the grey-white knee-length stretcher-corps tunic freshly washed, a new white sash across the chest, the armband with the painted white candle over the sleeve, a leather belt with needles and thread, a white head-cloth, a single candle held in both hands whose flame never gutters. She stands very straight, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait, the face large, the honey eyes with the white glint looking straight at the viewer with a level, kind look. Warm candle light from below on one side and cool grey dusk on the other. Foreground blur: a candle flame and drifting ash. She wears the white-grey robe and the armband.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: crouched and braced low with one arm under the stretcher pole, the other hand flat out toward the wounded, a steady intent look.

name: 阿兹罗
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1437
who: Azro, a demon-kin soldier of the northern edge of the dead zone, forty-one years old, about 186 cm, tall and lean with long arms and strong legs. A pair of horns curve back from his forehead, the colour of unpainted wood, the tips worn blunt and never lit by fire. Black hair shaved very short to show the horns. Dark gold eyes that look at the ground more carefully than at people. Many scars across the front of his body, none on the back. A taciturn, careful, trustworthy air: the one who probes the swamp ahead so the others do not sink.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, long man's face of about forty, NOT young: lines at the eye corners and between the brows, dark gold narrow eyes, level black brows, a straight nose, a thin even mouth; a pair of wood-coloured horns curving back from the forehead. Skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 186 cm, tall, lean and long-armed: lean shoulders, long strong legs, a straight back.
palette: unpainted wood brown and mud grey, dark gold, dull iron, black
casual: The leather armour of the vanguard path-probers, a single plate of iron nailed to the chest and none on the back; in his right hand a long spear shaft with an iron cap, notches cut up its length as depth marks; at his belt a rolled leather strip written with his family's three lines. Mud-caked boots. He stands with the shaft planted, looking down, a calm, watchful look.
private: Off duty beside a camp fire: the armour off, a plain undyed wool shirt with open collar, dark trousers, soft boots, a wool blanket round his shoulders; he is whittling a new notch into the spear shaft, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Leading a line through a bog under attack: the leather armour with its iron breast plate buckled tight, leather bracers, the shaft held in both hands low and forward testing the ground, one foot half raised; his head turned to the ground ahead, a cautious, intent look.
formal: At a soldiers' memorial in the camp of the horned: his own leather armour oiled and brushed, no tailored coat, the iron breast plate polished bright and cut with a line of old runes that glow a dull ember red, leather straps crossing the chest with the strip of his family's three lines tied at the heart, a short oiled-canvas half-cloak, the horns bare. He stands very straight with the shaft held upright at his side, a grave look.
art: A portrait, the face large, the dark gold eyes lowered to the ground and then lifted slowly to the viewer. Pale grey swamp light from one side. Foreground blur: the notched spear shaft and drifting mist. He wears the leather armour with the iron plate.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: the spear shaft held in both hands low in front probing the ground, a cautious forward step, eyes on the ground.

name: 布伦希
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1493
who: Brunhild, a dwarf gunner of the Cliff branch of Ironmelt, seventy-two years old and a young adult dwarf with the build and bearing of a man of about thirty: about 136 cm, short, broad, thick-armed with a short neck. A red-brown beard plaited in two strands held with copper rings. Pale grey eyes that do not blink at the flash of a muzzle. Strangely slender, long-fingered hands with copper filings in the nail beds. A taciturn, patient, dutiful air; he stands behind the gun all day and does not shift.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad-jawed young adult dwarf man's face of about thirty, NOT old and no wrinkles: pale grey steady eyes under straight red-brown brows, a short wide nose, a closed firm mouth half hidden in the red-brown beard. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 136 cm, a dwarf's build: short and broad, shoulders thick, arms heavy, a short neck, a stocky firm stance.
palette: red-brown and polished copper, forge black, smoke grey, dull steel
casual: The leather apron of the Cliff branch with a row of small engraving chisels hanging from it, a fur-lined leather cap with ear flaps pushed back on his head, a copper tag on a cord at his neck on which the names of the previous shift's gunners are cut, a coarse wool shirt with rolled sleeves, heavy boots. He stands with his arms folded, a calm, patient look.
private: Off duty in a camp tent: the apron off, a plain wool shirt and braces, the ear-flapped cap hanging on a peg, his beard unbound over his shoulders; he is engraving a line into a small copper plate with a fine chisel, a tired, content look.
battle: At his great cannon, a magic-crystal cannon and not a gunpowder gun: a squat rune-cut iron and brass barrel on a wheeled carriage, a fist-sized blue-white magic crystal glowing in a caged housing at the breech, rune lines along the barrel lit from within. The leather apron buckled tight, the ear-flapped cap pulled down, smoked mica goggles, leather gauntlets, a bandolier of engraved copper fuse tags across the chest; one hand on the firing cord, the other braced on the crystal housing, the legs planted wide. A rigid, focused look.
formal: At the muster of the gun crews: a clean grey issue coat of the Cliff branch left open over his leather apron, brass rivets at the shoulders, the copper tag of names polished on his chest, the beard rings freshly shined, the ear-flapped cap held under one arm, a small blue crystal charm at his belt faintly glowing. He stands very straight, a grave look.
art: A portrait, the face large, the pale grey eyes steady and unblinking against a flash of light. Orange muzzle-flash light from one side, cool grey smoke on the other. Foreground blur: the copper chisel in his slender fingers and drifting smoke. He wears the leather apron and the ear-flapped cap.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced at the breech of a great cannon, one hand on the firing cord, a rigid focused look.

name: 埃因
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1549
who: Ein, a dwarf rune-smith of the Rune branch of Ironmelt, two hundred and fifty-six years old, an old dwarf: about 131 cm, short, the back bowed but the shoulders still wide. A white beard plaited in seven strands, each strand held with a copper ring. Verdigris-green eyes behind a pair of round copper-framed spectacles; he reads very close to the page. Both hands are covered in chisel and fire scars, the last half of the left little finger missing, crushed by a sluice gate he engraved as a young man. A quiet, exacting, kindly air. His LEFT hand (the hand on the viewer's right when he faces us) is missing the last half of its little finger: that finger ends in a short rounded stump at the middle joint, plainly shorter than the ring finger beside it, drawn that way in every panel where the hand shows; the right hand has all five fingers whole. The stump of the left little finger is wound with a thin strip of dark leather, an old smith's habit, so the short finger is easy to spot in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: the face of a very old dwarf man, NOT young: deep lines across the forehead and at the eye corners, heavy white brows, verdigris-green eyes behind round copper-framed spectacles, a short broad nose, a mouth hidden in the long white beard. Skin shadows a soft warm brown.
build: 131 cm, a dwarf's build: short, the back bowed forward, shoulders still wide, thick forearms.
palette: verdigris green and old copper, white beard, forge black, soot brown
casual: The black leather apron of the Rune branch with a row of chisels and calipers hanging from it, a leather case at his belt holding a hand-written notebook with a blank cover, a shield-clasp on a cord at his neck, a wool shirt with rolled sleeves, thick boots. He stands stooped, a hand resting on the leather case, a patient look. The left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) lies flat on the leather case, palm down, drawn large with the fingers spread wide: thumb, index, middle and ring fingers are whole, but in the place of the little finger there is only a short knob of a stump half the length of the ring finger, its end wound round with a thin strip of dark leather; that hand shows four long fingers and one short wrapped knob.
private: At rest in his workshop alcove: the apron off, a long-sleeved faded green wool robe tied at the waist, soft slippers, the beard unbound; the spectacles pushed up on his forehead, a cup of hot drink in both hands, a drowsy, content look. The cup is held so the left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is nearest the viewer, its little finger a short leather-wrapped stump half the length of the other fingers.
battle: Not a soldier, working under fire as the rune-smith: the black apron belted close, a leather skullcap on his head, a chisel in the right hand and a small mallet in the left, the spectacles on his nose. A focused, tense look. The small mallet is in the left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us), the back of the hand toward the viewer: index, middle and ring fingers curl round the handle, and in the place of the little finger there is only a short leather-wrapped stump, half a finger long, sticking out stiffly beside the handle without reaching round it.
formal: At the gathering of the elders: the black leather apron of the Rune branch scrubbed and worn over a dark green wool shirt, a stone-grey shoulder mantle clasped with a copper ring, the beard rings polished, the spectacles in place, rune lines on the apron hem glowing softly green. He stands bowed but dignified, a solemn look. Both hands rest on top of a short staff, the left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) on top with fingers spread: its little finger is only a short leather-wrapped stump half the length of the ring finger, so that hand shows four long fingers and one short knob.
art: A portrait, the face large, the green eyes looking close and clear through the round spectacle lenses. Warm forge light on one side, cool grey on the other. Foreground blur: the chisel in his scarred fingers and drifting metal dust. He wears the black apron.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing with the feet planted, a chisel raised in one hand and a small mallet in the other, a focused tense look.

name: 纳丝塔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1691
who: Nasta of the Iron Kettle family, a dwarf furnace-hand of the seventh bastion, sixty-nine years old and a young adult dwarf with the face and build of a woman of about thirty: about 139 cm, a head and more shorter than a human woman, broad-shouldered and sturdy. Apricot-gold hair in two thick braids, the ends held with copper rings. Slate-blue eyes that look close at the glow of the furnaces. Eyebrows curled by steam, impossible to smooth, as with all the Iron Kettle family. On the backs of both hands rows of white burn marks in the shape of furnace mouths. A cheerful, stubborn, practical air.
face: FACE, as in the references: the face of a sturdy young adult dwarf woman of about thirty, a grown woman's face: round strong cheeks flushed from the heat, slate-blue eyes, steam-curled eyebrows that stand up, a short nose, a wide firm mouth. Skin shadows a soft warm pink-orange.
build: 139 cm, short and sturdy: broad shoulders, thick strong arms, a solid trunk, a C-cup, a firm waist and fully rounded hips.
palette: apricot gold and furnace orange, slate blue, tarnished copper, soot black
casual: The leather apron of a furnace-hand of Furnace Street with a long-handled scraper and a copper spanner hanging from it, a tin cup on a cord at her waist worn bright at the rim, a damp cloth wound round her neck, a coarse wool shirt with rolled sleeves, heavy boots. She stands with a scraper over one shoulder, a cheerful, straightforward look.
private: Off duty in the camp: the apron off, a long-sleeved faded blue wool dress to the shins with a cloth belt, wool stockings, the braids pinned up around her head, a kettle in her hands; a tired, warm smile.
battle: Holding the furnace line under attack, a furnace-hand not a swordswoman: the apron buckled tight, leather gauntlets on, the damp cloth pulled over her mouth; both hands gripping a long iron scraper-pole angled across her body like a spear, the legs planted wide, braced against the heat. A fierce, determined look.
formal: At the feast of the bastion: a clean dark blue wool jerkin with copper rivets over a pale shirt, the leather furnace-hand apron scrubbed and kept on, a short red scarf at the neck, the tin cup polished on its cord at her waist, the braids pinned up with copper rings, a tiny ember in a glass bead on one braid that never goes out. She stands very straight, a proud, solemn look.
art: A portrait, the face large, the slate-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a cheerful stubborn look. Hot orange furnace light on one side, cool grey on the other. Foreground blur: the rim of the bright tin cup and drifting sparks. She wears the leather apron with the damp cloth at her neck.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: both hands gripping a long iron scraper-pole angled across the body like a spear, legs planted wide, braced against the heat.

name: 桑洛
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1747
who: Sanlo, a sea demon-kin tide-watcher of the Deep Tide, twenty-two years old, about 181 cm, tall and slender with long arms and a narrow waist, a grown young man. Thin webbing between his fingers, two gill slits at the sides of his neck that close on land. Pearl-white skin with fine silver scales along the neck and forearms that turn faintly blue when wet. A short head of sea-blue hair that clings to his forehead when damp. Coral-red eyes with round pupils. Behind each ear a translucent fin instead of an ordinary ear, normally lying flat against his hair and spreading when he listens to the tide. A quiet, attentive, steady air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean young man's face of about twenty-two: coral-red round-pupilled eyes, fine sea-blue brows, a straight nose, a gentle even mouth; behind the ears translucent pale fins instead of human ears, and a trace of fine silver scales at the cheekbones. Pearl-white skin, shadows a soft cool blue.
build: 181 cm, tall, slender and long-armed: narrow waist and shoulders, long legs, a swimmer's body.
palette: sea blue and pearl white, coral red, silver, seaweed green
casual: The short smock of a Deep Tide tide-watcher, linen woven with sinews of sea-grass so that it does not rot in water, the sleeves rolled to the elbow; at his belt a roll of tide tables he has copied out himself, a single palm-sized conch shell hung round his neck on a cord, bare feet. He stands relaxed with both hands empty at his sides, a calm look. There is only ONE conch, the one on the cord at his neck; nothing is held in the hands and no second shell anywhere.
private: Resting on the shingle at the shore: a loose long-sleeved pale blue linen shirt hanging open at the collar and soft grey trousers, bare feet in the shallows, the damp hair tousled, a tide table on his knee; a quiet, gentle look.
battle: Standing guard on the shore of a besieged bastion, a watcher not a duellist: the smock belted close, leather bracers over the sleeves, the conch at his neck; a short spear of bone-white sea-ivory held in both hands low across the body, the feet planted in the water, the ear fins spread wide to listen. An alert, intent look.
formal: At the war council in the camp: a knee-length sea-grass overcoat open at the front over a pale shirt, shell buttons at the cuffs, silver braid at the hems, a woven belt with the conch on a fine silver chain, fine water-patterns that flow along the sleeves, the fins visible, the hair neatly combed. He stands straight with his hands folded behind him, a grave, polite look.
art: A portrait, the face large, the coral eyes looking straight at the viewer with a quiet, attentive look, the ear fins spread. Cool blue sea light on one side with a ripple of reflected light across the face. Foreground blur: water drops and the pale curve of the conch. He wears the sea-grass smock.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: a short spear held low in both hands, feet planted in shallow water, the ear fins spread wide, an alert look.

name: 罗迪·辕铃
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1894
who: Rodi of the Shaftbell family, a halfling train driver of the Star-Gauze rail, sixty-one years old and looking about sixty: about 102 cm, short, round and thick-waisted. A ginger curly head of hair with a large patch of white at the temples and back, the eyebrows still ginger. A round face whose nose wrinkles first when he smiles. Honey-coloured eyes, usually squinting from long hours looking down the rails. The last half of the left little finger is missing, lost to a coupling hook. Ash stains that will not wash off the backs of his hands and a patch of small white burn dots on his knuckles. A good-humoured, steady air. His LEFT hand (the hand on the viewer's right when he faces us) is missing the last half of its little finger: that finger ends in a short rounded stump at the middle joint, plainly shorter than the ring finger beside it, drawn that way in every panel where the hand shows; the right hand has all five fingers whole. The stump of the left little finger is bound with a strip of soot-grey cloth tape, a driver's habit against sparks, so the short finger is easy to spot in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round, cheerful halfling face with soft youthful features, slightly lined by sixty years: smile lines at the eyes, honey-coloured eyes narrowed a little, ginger brows, a nose that wrinkles when he smiles, ruddy round cheeks, a wide mouth. Skin shadows a soft warm pink.
palette: deep rail blue and ember orange, ginger, honey, soot black
casual: The short thick wool jacket of the rail guild's drivers, deep blue, its cuffs bound in leather against furnace sparks; at his belt a long-handled shovel for feeding the crystal furnace and a water flask, a sweat cloth round his neck with a tiny bell embroidered in its corner, soft-soled halfling shoes whose soles are faced with iron sheet. He stands with the shovel over his shoulder, his nose crinkled in a grin. The left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) rests on the hip, drawn large with the fingers spread flat against the jacket: thumb, index, middle and ring fingers are whole, but in the place of the little finger there is only a short knob of a stump half the length of the ring finger, its end bound with a strip of soot-grey cloth tape; that hand shows four long fingers and one short bound knob.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved faded blue wool shirt and braces over brown trousers, the sleeves rolled, soft slippers; he sits with a mug of hot drink, the sweat cloth in his lap, a drowsy, content grin. The sweat cloth hangs loosely from his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) with the fingers open: index, middle and ring fingers hang long, and in the place of the little finger there is only a short cloth-bound stump half their length.
battle: Driving the war train under attack, a driver not a swordsman: the deep blue jacket buttoned to the neck, leather gauntlets, a pair of smoked mica goggles pulled down; one hand pulling the throttle lever, the other gripping the long shovel held forward like a short spear, the legs braced on an iron plate. A hard, steady look. The left gauntlet (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has a stubby little finger half the length of the others, because the finger inside it is only a stump; that gauntlet reads as four long fingers and one short one.
formal: At the rail guild's gathering: a clean deep-blue wool guild jacket with leather-bound cuffs worn open over a white shirt, a brass rail-guild badge with a small chime on its chain, the small embroidered bell cloth tied round the neck, the shovel left behind. He stands upright with his thumbs in his belt, a proud grin. The thumbs are hooked in the belt with the other fingers spread flat on the coat: the right hand (on the viewer's left) has four whole fingers, while the left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) shows index, middle and ring fingers whole and, in the place of the little finger, only a short cloth-bound knob half their length.
art: A portrait, the face large, the honey eyes squinting a little with the nose-wrinkling grin. Warm orange furnace-glow from one side and cool blue dusk from the other. Foreground blur: a brass bell and drifting sparks. He wears the deep blue jacket and the sweat cloth.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: one hand on a throttle lever, the other gripping a long shovel held forward like a short spear, legs braced, a hard steady look.

name: 露伊塞·雁渡
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1950
who: Luise of the Wild Geese Ford family, a human gunnery calculator of the Institute at Star Ring, twenty-three years old, about 157 cm, small and slim with narrow shoulders, sitting very straight. Straight ice-blue hair cut to the chin with a neat blunt fringe, the tips always flicking up first toward whichever side the wind comes from. Pale violet eyes that lean close when she reads a dial. An ink callus on the right middle finger and a stub of charcoal tucked behind her left ear that she forgets is there. A precise, shy, absent-minded air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a delicate young woman's face of about twenty-three: pale violet almond eyes, thin straight ice-blue brows, a small straight nose, a small closed mouth; clear skin, shadows a soft cool pink.
build: 157 cm, slender: narrow shoulders, thin long-fingered hands, a B-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: ice blue and charcoal grey, pale violet, brass, ink black
casual: The Institute calculator's long charcoal-grey coat closed down the front with buttons, a small brass ring pin at the collar, a leather tube at her belt holding salvo tables and diagrams, fingerless knitted gloves, a stub of charcoal behind her left ear, low boots. She stands with a notebook against her chest, a distracted, careful look.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved pale grey wool dress to the shins with a high collar, wool stockings, soft slippers, a large knitted shawl over her shoulders; she sits with a notebook and a mug of hot drink, an absent-minded look.
battle: Calculating on a firing line, a calculator not a swordswoman: the charcoal coat belted close, a leather satchel across the chest; a long brass range-ruler held in both hands across the body like a quarterstaff, a tablet of tables hung at her belt, the legs braced against the rumble of the guns. A tense, focused look.
formal: At the Institute's yearly assembly: a charcoal wool coat worn open to the waist over a white blouse and a pleated slate skirt, the brass ring pin polished at the collar, a leather range-tube at her belt, white gloves, a thin chain at the wrist carrying a small calculating bead that glows pale blue, the ice-blue hair neatly combed. She stands very straight with a folded sheet of tables in both hands, a grave, polite look.
art: A portrait, the face large, the pale violet eyes leaning close to the viewer, the hair-tips lifted by wind. Cool pale morning light from one side and a warm brass glow on the other. Foreground blur: drifting paper scraps and the edge of a brass instrument. She wears the charcoal coat with the ring pin.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: a long brass range-ruler held across the body in both hands, braced against the rumble of the guns, a tense focused look.

name: 厄尔贡
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:2006
who: Orgun, an ox demon-kin wall-mason of the Thunder-Gaol, fifty-eight years old, about 231 cm, huge, broad and heavy, filling a doorway entirely, the muscles of his back in knots. Deep bronze skin that looks like sun-warmed copper. A pair of thick short horns curving forward, the tip of his left horn bound in an iron ring that his father made for him after building the wall round a forge-camp (on the viewer's right when they face us). Stiff brush-like russet-red hair cropped short. Copper-gold eyes that narrow when he studies a wall and open wide when he looks at a person. Hands broad as shovels, the palms bleached white by mortar. A slow, quiet, dependable air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a heavy-jawed, broad man's face of about fifty-eight, NOT young: deep lines at the forehead and eye corners, copper-gold eyes, thick russet-red brows, a broad flat nose, a firm wide mouth; deep bronze skin, shadows a soft warm brown; short thick bull horns, the left one with an iron ring round the tip.
build: 231 cm, huge and heavy: very broad shoulders that could carry a door-beam, thick arms and a deep chest, thick legs.
palette: bronze copper and mortar grey, russet red, dull iron, ash brown

name: 奥丽安
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:2152
who: Orian, a human pilot-rider of the first mechs of the Southern Wall, forty-seven years old, about 176 cm, tall, broad-shouldered and thick through the back and waist, standing with her feet a fist apart as though still gripping stirrups. Long mist-purple hair braided into one thick braid coiled at the back of her head, small enough to fit under a furnace-armour helm, with a few white hairs at the temples. Cobalt-blue eyes that do not squint at distance but narrow at nearby faces. On the left cheekbone a white scar from the edge of a furnace-armour faceplate, twenty years old (on the viewer's right when they face us). A steady, practical, horsewoman's air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a strong, handsome woman's face of about forty-seven, NOT young: fine lines at the eye corners and mouth, cobalt-blue almond eyes, level mist-purple brows, a straight nose, a firm mouth; a white scar on the left cheekbone (on the viewer's right when they face us). build: 176 cm, tall and strong: broad shoulders, a thick back and waist, powerful thighs, a C-cup, firm rounded hips.
palette: mist purple and cobalt blue, white and aged leather brown, dull steel
casual: A furnace-armour rider's padded arming coat of thick wool, its elbows and knees stitched with leather, a worn-out embroidered white kite with folded wings on the shoulder, its thread worn down to a ghost of itself (a white kite, the bird of prey with wings closed, NOT a diamond kite); at her belt an old horse's reins she holds in her hand when she sits in the cockpit. private: Off duty: a long-sleeved faded blue wool shirt tucked into brown riding trousers with a plain belt, soft boots, the braid undone and hanging over one shoulder; she mends a strap with a needle, a quiet, tired look.

art: A portrait, the face large, the cobalt eyes looking level and unflinching, the white scar visible. Cool pale morning light from one side and warm iron-red from a furnace on the other. Foreground blur: the old leather reins and drifting steam. She wears the arming coat with the faded kite.

who: Clovis of the Bell-tail family, a rabbit-eared beast-kin courier of the rear guard, twenty-one years old, about 154 cm, small with long legs and hard muscle in the calves, a grown young woman. Short snow-white hair that streams backward when she runs. Cherry-red eyes; her ears turn first toward whatever she looks at. Around one ankle a ring of fine Bell-tail bells that ring with each step.
